summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward long-term bullishness on the broad market, evidenced by massive $1.15B+ in SPX 7000C purchases for 2026/2027 expirations. While META and NDX show bearish intraday sentiment (high P/C ratios), the dominant conviction lies in massive, multi-day accumulations of SPX 7000C and 8000C strikes, totaling billions in persistent interest. Notable aggressive buying is also present in MU ($381.6M BuyCall) and AMD ($67.4M BuyCall), signaling a concentrated bet on the semiconductor sector. Traders should watch for continued upward momentum in SPX to test the support of these massive 7000-level call walls, while monitoring for any reversal in the high-premium META and NDX put flow.
